_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-55 directional hit rate over the last 7 days makes HOLD the only statistically honest call — the August analog and stablecoin buildup argue for eventual upside, but the ETF flow collapse (-55) and negative MVRV divergence mean the coil hasn't resolved, so we hold at Denial with eyes on Anxiety (down) if ETF flows stay below 10 and VIX breaks 22.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward-calls Disbelief (illegally, 2 rungs up) with HOLD direction; narrative implies upside accumulation. Consensus reconciles to HOLD with Anxiety as the legal downside risk if the coil breaks downward.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND funding stays below 0.001% with BTC holding $62k — this confirms the August-bottom analog is playing and shifts bias toward LONG.
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay below 10 AND VIX breaks 22 with BTC losing $60k — this kills the bottom analog and pushes the phase to Anxiety, shifting bias toward REDUCE.
